summary: SEL01 (iter56) end-to-end testing complete. 17/17 backend e2e tests pass + 9/9 unit tests pass. Frontend RBAC, render, save, toggle, and run flows all working. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: OK: client_config_service.upsert validates max_daily_audits in (0,500] and scheduler_time HH:MM; preserves omitted fields by reading existing doc.
OK: routes/selection_routes.py auto-creates legacy client_config (selection_enabled=false) on first GET — non-breaking by design.
OK: routal_selection_worker._select_drivers is a pure function with deterministic seed (YYYYMMDD); algorithm phase-1/phase-2/mixed/none all covered.
OK: idempotency in run_daily_selection: pre-existing 'selected' rows skipped from journey re-creation; 'unselected' rows wiped before re-eval; staged plans marked processed=True.
Minor (informational): scheduler_loop polls every 60s with last_scheduled_run_date guard — relies on leader_election in lifespan (per spec), not validated here.
Minor: GET /selection/summary uses cfg.last_scheduled_run_date directly; ok for read-only display.

context_for_next_testing_agent: SEL01 module fully validated. test_iter56_sel01_e2e.py is the regression suite — runs against live API using auth from test_credentials.md. Uses far-future dates (+40/+50/+60 days from today CDMX) to avoid clashing with scheduler last_run state. Cleanup is via test_/Test_ prefix. The 9 unit tests in test_iter56_selection.py cover the pure algorithm. UI testids present: tab-auditorias, audit-card-{cid}, audit-enabled-badge-{cid}, max-daily-{cid}, scheduler-time-{cid}, selection-enabled-{cid}, save-audit-{cid}, run-selection-{cid}, audit-summary-{cid}.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Bootstrap behavior confirmed: Cubbo auto-bootstrapped at startup (selection_enabled=true, max=30, time=06:00); legacy clients (Grupo Nadro) auto-create on first GET with selection_enabled=false. PATCH validation rejects scheduler_time='bad' with 400 and max_daily_audits=999/0 with 422 (Pydantic Field gt=0,le=500). PATCH preserves omitted fields. RBAC: developer→200, coordinator→403 on /client-config but 200 on /selection/run, agent+proveedor→403 on both. Algorithm: 5 fresh drivers + max_daily=30 → all phase_1 (5/5); max_daily=2 → 2 phase_1 + 3 unselected; idempotent re-run preserves journey count. /drivers/audit-history requires client_id query (422 without).
